name: X-LAB RT9 frameset
why_interesting: X-LAB's climbing-focused RT9: a Toray T1100 + M40X frame with an official 550 g unpainted size-M weight and a 30C maximum tire clearance. The mainland store sells the frameset at CNY 26,800; internationally a 6.20 kg Dura-Ace Di2 complete bike is also listed.
missing: Fork weight and complete frameset-package weight
Independent frame weight or stiffness measurement
Final dealer stock, delivery total and mainland warranty issuer

official_price.price_basis: Official mainland RT9 frameset: frame, fork, carbon integrated handlebar and carbon seatpost
official_price.conditions: Official listing price; final price varies by location and delivery method.

source_note: The catalog row uses the official mainland frameset package. The carbon grade, UDH compatibility, bottom bracket and 30C clearance come from the international RT9 page; the international complete bike stays separate below.

facts.frame: XDS carbon frame, Toray T-1100 + M40X, UDH compatible (international page)
facts.frame_material: Toray T-1100 + M40X carbon frame and Toray T-1100 fork (international page); lay-up unpublished
facts.frame_weight_basis: Official mainland page: unpainted size-M frame without fork and seatpost; the international page says about 550 g.
facts.seatpost: 27.2 mm carbon seatpost (international page); 300 mm carbon seatpost included in the mainland frameset
facts.cockpit: Carbon integrated handlebar included; 360×80 to 400×120 mm by size
facts.included_package: Frame, fork, carbon integrated handlebar and carbon seatpost (mainland frameset)
facts.geometry: Official chart, stack/reach mm: XS 510/362, S 525/372, M 543/384, L 567/396

alternative_builds.label: International RT9 complete bike, Shimano Dura-Ace Di2
alternative_builds.notes: US$9,150 complete or US$3,499 frameset only on the international page on 2026-10-27, with shipping in the contiguous U.S.; not a mainland China price.
